headline: Committee cuts two grant items, keeps $2.5 million for village wastewater project

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.voteItem: Decrease item 14, renewable energy program grants, by $50,000 and lower the fund transfer to match
meeting.summary: The committee cut $100,000 from Green Building and Resilient Housing Grants and $50,000 from renewable energy grants. A motion to delete $2.5 million for a village association's wastewater project failed four to four; motions on Finance positions and software also failed.
meeting.recap: The committee cut $100,000 from Green Building and Resilient Housing Grants, with eight ayes and one member excused.[[0:07:09]] The committee cut $50,000 from renewable energy program grants, with eight ayes and one member excused.[[0:08:35]] A member moved to delete $2.5 million for a village association's effort to stop using injection wells.[[0:10:38]] The member said the county has not answered how much it will pay in total for the project.[[0:11:40]] The budget director said the project is estimated to cost $12.48 million to $16.14 million.[[0:23:43]] The director said the mayor pledged up to $9.5 million, spread over years.[[0:23:46]] The director said any funding depends on council approval.[[0:24:04]] The motion to delete the money failed, four ayes to four noes, with one member excused.[[0:40:16]] In Finance, a member moved to cut $122,568 for accountant positions created in fiscal year 21.[[0:55:20]] A member moved to cut funding for service representative positions in the Motor Vehicle and Licensing Program.[[1:00:24]] That motion failed, three ayes to five noes, with one member excused.[[1:07:40]] A member moved to delete $50,000 for software to track internal controls and assess risk.[[1:08:38]] That motion failed, three ayes to six noes.[[1:15:55]]
decided: The committee cut $50,000 from renewable energy program grants, with eight ayes and one member excused.
The cut to the accounts program passed with eight ayes and one member excused.
The committee voted to reconsider its earlier cut to the accounts program, with eight ayes and one member excused.
The member who proposed the accounts program cut withdrew it, with no objection.
meeting.next: The budget director said she would get exact information on a $6 million increase in the countywide sewer capital improvement reserve fund. Countywide items will be taken up last. The committee planned to take up fire, housing, human concerns and liquor next.

moments.q: "That's four ayes, four nos, motion fails."
A member logs on during the roll call

issues.oneLine: A motion to delete $2.5 million for a village association's wastewater facility failed.
issues.why: One member said the current system is polluting the bay.
issues.next: The association expects to submit its DOH permit in September and get its building permit in October.
issues.brief: The budget director said the project is estimated to cost $12.48 million to $16.14 million.[[#1]] The director said the mayor pledged up to $9.5 million, spread over years.[[#2]] The director said construction would start in fiscal year 27.[[#3]] The association has received $1 million from the EPA and $250,000 from a private donor.[[#4]]
